Sleight of Hand / Feint Action (DEX)
Flail Basics: +2 gear with this Feint skill check while holding a reviewed readied flail; gear bonuses do not stack (p.178). Feint: opposed Sleight of Hand(DEX), Hands-On and Vision; one half action; base error1 plus action error+1 on both checks (pp.352,357). The GC confirms that the Feint target has not been targeted by a successful Feint this round. The loser becomes flat-footed. A winning critical success or losing critical failure gives the winner +2 with the next attack against the loser, expiring at the end of the following round if unused. Resolve opposed results, critical activation, conditions, the target restriction and next-attack benefits separately. 1 Half Action. Active. Hands-On, Vision. Rules p.357.
